incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager alert (P1): elevated generation tail latency observed for hosted-prod-us-west-2. p95 jumped from ~120ms -> ~850ms over last 12m. Auto-run: trace-collect started. Incident ID: INC-2026-0315-01
aaron_oncall: picking this up. paging channel and starting triage. anyone on-call for runtime perf?
ev an_sre: evan_sre: on it, coming into traces now. can someone confirm customer-facing errors?
kai_support: Not seeing 5xx spike in logs, but slow responses causing timeouts for a few streaming sessions (CS case #3921).
maria_eng: is this affecting Dedicated customers or hosted only?
sam_platform: looks confined to hosted-prod-us-west-2; other regions normal. routing/balancer healthy.
evan_sre: pulling APM spans for a few requests (examples attached). p50 ~140ms (ok), p95 ~800-900ms. spans show long tail in "kv_cache.lookup" and kernel wait artifacts in last-span of generator process.
jess_research: hypothesis 1: recent kernel backport (sched/futex) applied to that pool 18m ago caused increased futex contending for our pinned worker threads. hypothesis 2: long GC/compaction in python agent causing blocking.
aaron_oncall: timeline so far: 00:00 alert triggered; 00:02 traces auto-collected; 00:05 ops paged; 00:10 kernel patch rolling finished on subset of hosts; 00:12 p95 starts climbing; 00:18 now.
ev an_sre: dumping perf counters from one affected host (short):
```
# perf stat -e context-switches,cpu-migrations,page-faults,cycles,instructions -a sleep 1
context-switches             1,234,567
cpu-migrations               12,345
page-faults                  23,456
cycles                      1,234,567,890
instructions                987,654,321
```
evan_sre: notable: context-switches and migrations high vs baseline. also seeing "futex_wait" stacks in perf top.
maria_eng: adding customer impact: CS reports 3 medium customers with timeouts during streaming. no data exfiltration.
sam_platform: routing show retries increased from 0.2% -> 6% in the window. burst autoscale not triggered because we are CPU bound on those nodes.
jess_research: sharing example trace snippet (abridged):
```
span: generate ->  total 860ms
  span: kv_cache.lookup  ->  420ms
  span: compute.step      ->  300ms
  span: net.write        ->  50ms
  span: flush/lock       ->  90ms (blocked on futex)
```
evan_sre: running `pstack` on blocked process shows many threads stuck in `__futex_wait` with owner != us. suspect kernel futex owner inheritance/regress.
aaron_oncall: mitigation attempt 1: draining the affected hosts and shifting traffic to warm spare pool. starting drain now.
sam_platform: drain in progress, 6/12 nodes drained; should reduce p95 if node-local kernel issue.
+10m
evan_sre: after draining 6 nodes p95 dropped to ~160ms. still some tail at ~220ms. looks like contaminated requests still in queue on one remaining host.
jess_research: marking hypotheses: H1 (kernel futex regression) = likely, H2 (python GC) = unlikely so far. adding H3 (kv store contention under new kernel) = possible.
maria_eng: can we capture perf + strace from one of the draining nodes before reboot? useful for vendor escalation.
ev an_sre: collected strace snippets and perf top, uploading to /internal/incident/3550012345/artifacts (link: https://redwood.internal/incident/3550012345). includes pstack, perf.data, and dmesg.
kai_support: created incident slack note for CS with mitigation steps and ETA to customers: shift to other region or retry.
aaron_oncall: handoff: i need to go offline for lunch in 8m. evan, can you take on-call lead and keep incident open?
ev an_sre: taking lead. i'll continue trace collection and escalate to kernel vendor if we confirm a backport is root cause.
jess_research: quick checklist to close: 1) confirm p95 returned to baseline across all hosts 2) collect perf traces pre-drain for vendor 3) get package/version lists for kernel on affected hosts 4) write short RCA draft.
sam_platform: kernel version list attached: `5.15.0-xyz-backport-2026-03-15` on affected, spares on 5.15.0-xyz-stable. diff in futex subsystem observed in changelog.
ev an_sre: escalated to kernel vendor with perf traces + pstack (ticket KERN-1024). vendor acknowledges similar regression in their backport. they requested repro with perf in synthetic load.
maria_eng: customer comms: sending initial update now: "we mitigated by draining affected hosts; some customers experienced streaming timeouts; root cause under investigation; we will follow up with RCA."
aaron_oncall: back from lunch, catching up. thanks evan. what's current state?
ev an_sre: p95 stable ~140-170ms across region after full drain and remediate. vendor confirmed regression in backport; roll back recommended.
jess_research: status of hypotheses: H1 -> confirmed (kernel backport futex regression), H3 -> possible but likely downstream of H1, H2 -> ruled out.
aaron_oncall: next steps: schedule emergency roll-back for the backport in prod pool tonight (change request CR-3550012345). create post-incident RCA doc and include perf artifacts.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0315-01 status changed -> mitigated. auto-note: pages: 3, duration: 47m.
emoticons: :thumbsup:
